content: Rauguguya be raukivigewagewa Tesalonaika nopone
Raḡanine taudi a babara naḡona Ampipolis be Apolonia meagaidima, a gosedi be Tesalonaikama a tavatavana, dabudine Jius adi sinagogma a kitana.
Naumeki da Pol tauna nopone ya naḡona maika noḡone na kaba voiama nama. Sabat rabuiteḡa nopodie tauna banaga mate buka poredima girugirumidima ai tarapiriedi

be ya giugiu waibatedina da Tauwai yawasana ei nuatoitoi be gurie e midisuḡu munaḡana yawai maḡataridina. Tauna umanama ya riuriuna, “Uma Yesunama taugu ḡaromie yà rarau guguyena tauna Tauwai yawasana”.
Naumeki da Jius banegidima ḡesaudima ai sumaḡa be Pol be Saelas ai muriwatanedina. Be teneḡinama nama Gurik banegidima Mamaitua taurauduneenama toitoi be waiwaivi isanaḡonaḡodima bisanama.

Be Jius banegidima a unurana, vutuna aubainama banaga adi yawasanama gewegewedima anikune gabune a rawateḡeidina, be taudi iḡara inam meagaine ai karena. Taudi a naḡo Jeison na vadae a saḡana. Taudi Pol be Saelas a wanewanedina da sibo a dobiḡedina banaga ḡarodie.

Be taudi a wana rereḡedina aubainama, Jeison be tauwai sumaḡa ḡesaudima a soru dobiḡedina meagai babadidima noḡodie, be bonedima dosine a riuna, “Uma tautauḡomidima taudi gewagewa dobu matabuna a voivoiedina be yodi uma a tavana.
Be Jeison ya riuedi da na vadae ya saḡedina. Be taudi Sisa na giuma a rawaḡaiḡaiedi be a riuna da banaga ḡesaunama, tauna guyau, isanama Yesu.”
Raḡanine taudi umanama giudima a vaivaiedina, patara be meagai babadidima ma medidi a naḡo midisuḡuna.
Dabudine babada Jeison na banagama mate a riuedi da mane bisa a ḡoeḡoedina nama ai maesa be a riuporedi da a naḡona.
Pol be Saelas a naḡona Berea meagaine
Raḡanine kupi ya tavatavana tauwai sumaḡa Pol be Saelas a riupore nawedina Bereama. Dabudine a tavatavana, taudi Jius adi sinagogma nopone a naḡona.

Be banaga dabudi Bereama miemienidima taudi banaga veredima, nam Tesalonaika banegidima maika. Baninama taudi raḡan matabuna Mamaitua riunama nuedima tabutabune a vaivaie be a paḡopaḡona. Dabudine taudi girugiruminama poranama raḡan patapatanama a kitakita yaḡedina, da aba Pol ya riuriuedina inam riukaua bo ibewa.
Be Jius banegidima toitoi be Gurik waiwaividi be tautauḡomidima isanaḡonaḡodima toitoi matabudi ai sumaḡana.
Raḡanine Jius banegidima Tesalonaikama ta vaiena be Pol Mamaitua riunama Bereama ya rarau guguyena, taudi mate dabudi a naḡo be patara a kawa nopogedegederidina.
Naumeki da tauwai sumaḡa Pol waiḡapa a riupore nawena gerese, be Saelas be Timoti Bereama a mia kwasana.
Be tautauḡoma aitauḡa Pol awai dokena taudi mate a naḡona, naumeki da Aten paratinama. Be Pol na giuma a munaḡena Bereama da Saelas be Timoti ta riuedi be yaḡiyaḡina Pol murine ta naḡona.
Pol Aten nopone
Raḡanine Pol yaḡoro Saelas be Timoti Atensma ya raberabedina, tauna yai nuaboya kauana, baninama e kitana be meagai noponama kokoitau ya moḡavuna.
Tauna Jius be Gurik tauwai sumaḡa banegidima mate sinagog nopone ai tarapirina, be raḡan patapatanama anikune gabune aitauḡa a tavatavana mate awai tarapirina.

Dabudine tautauḡoma nuanuauyauyedima Epikuria be Stoiki damdima, taudi Pol umanama a riu virevirena, “Inam baneginama giugiu buabuanama aba e giue?” Be banaga ḡesaudima a riuna, “Anikitanama maika tauna wari dobu mamaituedima e giugiuedina.” Nama taudi a riuna, baninama Yesu tauna gurie be ya midisuḡu munaḡana, vutuna Pol ya rarau guguyena.
Dabudine taudi Pol ai doka nawena Areopagas oyanama
debane be a riuena, “Tauma sibo kè kataie da uma waikatakatainama vaunama aba tam kwai katakataiedi?
Tam am giuma vaiedima ditabu beamaie ta yovoyovona. Vutuna aubainama tauma ka ḡoeḡoena da am giuma pakanama sibo kè katai kauena.”
Naumeki Aten banegidima be vaḡavaḡai matabudi dabudi miemienidima taudi nam aba noyanama ti voivoiena, be taudi raḡan matabuna a miaboni be giu vaudima a giugiuedi be awai beavaiedina.
Dabudine Areopagas oyane adi kaba waiborue dabudine Pol ya midisuḡu be ya riuna, “Yau bana! Taugu yà kitakitana da taumi bariawa tabu be tabu ko rarau duneedina, maika kabe Mamaitua.

Taugu ami meagaiḡa è babababara naḡo raḡanine, taugu olta tenaḡa è banavina da debane umanama a girumana: Uma oltanama tauna mamaitua nam katakataiena tauna aubainama. Taumi uma Mamaituanama nam ko kataiena be ko rarau duneena. Tauna vutuna yodi yà rauguguyena ḡaromie.
“Inam Mamaituanama, tauna dobu be nopone yaba matabuna ya voiedina. Be tauna mara be dobu ewai badedina, be tauna nam vada banaga nimedie a voivoiedina nopodie ima miamiana.

Be banaga nam teneḡina da tauna tai kani be ta rabe, baninama tauna nam aba ḡarode ima ḡoeḡoena. Ibewa! Tauna vutuna yaba matabuna e raberabedina, be tauna yawasana, yavutu be yaba matabudi e uteutedina.

Tauna tauḡoma tenaḡa pakane yai tubuḡina be taune dam matabudi dobue yai tubuḡidina, baninama ya ḡoena da banaga sibo dobu matabuna a miana. Be tauna banaga adi raḡanima ya vinedi be adi kaba miama deḡo dabudine sibo a miana mate ya vinedina.
“Nama Mamaitua e voivoiana, baninama tauna e ḡoeḡoena da banaga ta wane be tai suratou gurata da ta banavina. Be tauna tauda diade be nam i naḡo poredana.
Baninama taune tà yawayawasana, tà naḡonaḡo be tà miamiana. Be ami sarema taubiridima ḡesaudima taudi umanama a vatovatodina, ‘Tauda tauna natunatunama.’
Vutuna aubainama tauda deḡoda Mamaitua Natunatunama, naumeki da tauda nam sibo tèi noḡotana Mamaitua tauna kokoitau, banaga adi nuauyauyae gold, siruva bo yekue a sarisaridina maika.
Dokane Mamaitua bua ya kita poredina, be yodi banaga dobu matabuna e riuriuedina da nuedima ta vitaredina,

baninama tauna raḡan ya vinena da airaḡan tauna dobue banaga matabudi adi voiama ruvane ei tarapiriedina. Be tauna tauḡoma tenaḡa ya vinena da tauna uma kauinama ei badena. Uma baneginama Mamaitua gurie ya kawa midisuḡu munaḡena, da matabuda sibo tè kataiena da Mamaitua uma noyanama tauna ya utena.”
Raḡanine taudi gurie midimidisuḡu muneḡinama a vaivaiena, dabudine ḡesaudima taudi ai kwatekwateve be ḡesaudima a riuna, “Tauma ka ḡoeḡoena uma riunama wari raḡan kwa giu munaḡe be ka vaiena.”
Naumeki da Pol ya gosedi be ya naḡona.

Be tautauḡoma bisanama na giuma ai sumaḡe be ai muriwatanena. Taudi nopodie tauḡoma tenaḡa isanama Dionisus, tauna Areopagas oyanama baneginama. Be ḡesau tauna waivinama isanama Damaris, be ḡesaudima mate.

footnotes.text: ‘Areopagas’ inam oya debane, be Aten banegidima nuanuauyeuyedima adi kaba waiboruma gabunama.
